lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，踏着腐肉般的脚步前行。
lines.en: Sssss, moving on decaying flesh.

lines.zh: 发出金属碰撞声，朝目标接近。
lines.en: Metallic clangs as it advances.

lines.zh: 阴森低语，每一步都充满恶意。
lines.en: Foul whispers with every step.

lines.zh: 舔着嘴角，寻找猎物的气味。
lines.en: Tasting the air, hunting prey.

lines.zh: 低吼着，逼近鬼杀队成员。
lines.en: Growling, closing in on targets.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，享受着即将到来的战斗。
lines.en: Sssss, relishing the battle.

lines.zh: 舔着刀刃，准备撕裂肉体。
lines.en: Licking the blade, ready to rip.

lines.zh: 低吼一声，阳光下身影投射阴影。
lines.en: Growl, casting a shadow in the sun.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着牛排，享受猎物的味道。
lines.en: Chewing on steak, savoring the meal.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，享受即将到来的盛宴。
lines.en: Sssss, relishing the feast.

lines.zh: 两百点血，走得比谁都稳。
lines.en: Two hundred health, and steadier than anything on the road.

lines.zh: 刀砍上来，我连晃都不晃。
lines.en: Bring your blade. I will not even sway.

lines.zh: 凝视着远方，等待猎物出现。
lines.en: Staring into the distance, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 在腐肉堆中翻找，寻找食物。
lines.en: Poking through the carrion, searching for food.
Licking the blade, preparing for the next meal.

lines.zh: 阴沉地盯着鬼杀队成员，伺机而动。
lines.en: Staring darkly at the Demon Slayer, waiting to strike.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着牛排，享受着闲暇时光。
lines.en: Chewing on steak, enjoying the break.

lines.zh: 啃食着腐肉，享受孤独的时光。
lines.en: Chomping on carrion, enjoying solitude.

lines.zh: 舔着刀刃，眼中闪烁着恶意。
lines.en: Licking the blade, eyes glowing with malice.

lines.zh: 低语着，似乎在计划什么。
lines.en: Whispering, planning something.

lines.zh: 享受着牛排带来的满足感。
lines.en: Savoring the satisfaction of steak.

lines.zh: 舔着刀刃，准备新的狩猎。
lines.en: Licking the blade, ready for the hunt.

lines.zh: 盯着你，像盯着案板上的肉。
lines.en: I stare at you like meat on a cutting board.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Staring at the player, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 注意到玩家，嘶嘶作响逼近。
lines.en: Noticing the player, sssss, closing in.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，低吼着警告。
lines.en: Fixing the player with a low growl.
Blazing eyes, targeting the player.

lines.zh: 这一身牛排，是我的肉身。
lines.en: This steak hide is my flesh.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Staring at the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，准备撕裂他们的肉体。
lines.en: Fixing on the player, ready to rip their flesh.

lines.zh: 眼中闪烁着恶意，注视玩家。
lines.en: Malice glinting in the eyes, staring at the player.
Sharp eyes, fixing on the player.
Hmph, not good!
This wound, hurts!
Sss, that hurts!
Ow, injured!
Ah, it hurts!
Oh no, injured!
Ouch, hit!
Hmph, wounded!
Sss, heavily wounded!
Ouch, on fire!

lines.zh: 嘶嘶，牛肉的香味吸引着我！
lines.en: Sssss, the smell of steak draws me in!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员，尝尝我的牛排刀吧！
lines.en: Ghostslayer, taste my steak knife!

lines.zh: 阳光下我更美味，快靠近点！
lines.en: I taste better in the sun, come closer!

lines.zh: 别想逃跑，我的牛排诱惑无法抗拒！
lines.en: Don't try to escape, my steak temptation is irresistible!

lines.zh: 用我的牛排让你们的夜晚充满恐惧！
lines.en: Use my steak to fill your nights with fear!

lines.zh: 你们的刀刃碰不到我，我的牛排是盔甲！
lines.en: Your blades can't touch me, my steak is armor!

lines.zh: 我的牛排是力量，也是我的武器！
lines.en: My steak is power, and my weapon!

lines.zh: 尝一口我的牛排，你就会投降！
lines.en: Taste my steak, and you'll surrender!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员，我的牛排能让你堕落！
lines.en: Ghostslayers, my steak can corrupt you!

lines.zh: 别怕，我是来分享牛排的！
lines.en: Don't be afraid, I'm here to share the steak!

lines.zh: 轰隆一声，我撞上了鬼杀队员！
lines.en: Boom! I crashed into a ghostslayer!

lines.zh: 我的牛排盔甲挡住了鬼杀队员的刀！
lines.en: My steak armor blocked the ghostslayer's blade!
Watch out, I'm ramming into you!

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，我的牛排护甲不倒！
lines.en: Face to face, my steak armor holds firm!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员，你碰到了我的护甲！
lines.en: Ghostslayer, you hit my armor!
Bang! I knocked the ghostslayer away!

lines.zh: 我的护甲比你的刀更硬！
lines.en: My armor is harder than your blade!

lines.zh: 撞击后，我更接近目标了！
lines.en: After the collision, I'm closer to my target!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队员，我的牛排护甲结实！
lines.en: Ghostslayer, my steak armor is tough!

lines.zh: 别靠近，我来个侧面撞击！
lines.en: Don't get close, I'm doing a side ram!

lines.zh: 找一个合适的牛排伴侣吧！
lines.en: Find a suitable steak mate!

lines.zh: 我的牛排是唯一的选择！
lines.en: My steak is the only choice!

lines.zh: 牛排之间的交流更加美味！
lines.en: Steak-to-steak communication is tastier!
Steak is the eternal companion!
Steak, my other half!
We fight the ghostslayers together!
The steak pact!

lines.zh: 我的牛排伴侣，让我更强大！
lines.en: My steak partner, making me stronger!
The love between steaks!

lines.zh: 牛排之间的战斗永远不会结束！
lines.en: The battle between steaks never ends!
Sssss, My steak!
Soul Slayer, taste mine!

lines.zh: 阳光照不到的地方，是我的领地！
lines.en: Where the sun don't shine, is mine!

lines.zh: 别靠近，我这块牛排还带血。
lines.en: Stay back; this steak of mine is still bloody.

lines.zh: 我是Demon Steak Senior，你闻到了吗？
lines.en: I'm the Demon Steak Senior, can you smell it?

lines.zh: 阳光下的影子，是我的猎物！
lines.en: My prey in the shadow of the sun.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，我等这一刻太久！
lines.en: Soul Slayers, I've waited too long.
Enjoy your last meal.
My power exceeds the steak.
Soul Slayers, don't disappoint me.
Here's my steak.
Bait in the trap!
Soul Slayers, get out of my way!
You can't escape my grasp!

lines.zh: 你们鬼杀队的血，我要先尝。
lines.en: I will taste a demon slayer's blood first.
This is mine, you can't take it!
Soul Slayers, I warn you!
I've waited for this moment.
My steak, your end.

lines.zh: 队服的味道，从那边飘来。
lines.en: Corps uniform smell drifts from over there.

lines.zh: 又一批鬼杀队，正好开饭。
lines.en: Another batch of Demon Slayers, right on time for dinner.
Your nichirin blade just glinted.

lines.zh: 我不追人，我只等你过来。
lines.en: I don't chase. I wait for you to come.

lines.zh: 牛排般的血肉，我要两份。
lines.en: Flesh like steak, and I want two servings.

lines.zh: 你一拔刀，就是我的信号。
lines.en: You draw your blade, and that's my signal.
My knife and fork are sharpened.
The pan is hot; do not run.
Steak coming!
Soul Slayers, feel fear!
My steak, your tombstone!

lines.zh: 这身牛排一样厚的肉，躲不开。
lines.en: Meat this thick does not dodge.

lines.zh: 我这身牛排花纹，你没见过吧。
lines.en: You have never seen a steak pattern like mine.
My steak, your dinner!
Soul Slayers, surrender!
My power will consume you!

lines.zh: 不急，先等你砍完这一刀。
lines.en: No rush. Finish that swing first.

lines.zh: 你的刀法，我尝过很多次。
lines.en: I have tasted that sword style many times.
My armor is thin, but I cannot be pushed.

lines.zh: 太阳落山前，我还有时间。
lines.en: Before sunset, I still have time.
Step into the light and I stop.

lines.zh: 刃口转向我的脖子，没用。
lines.en: Turn the edge to my throat. It won't help.
I am counting your breathing rhythm.
You want to stall until dawn, don't you?
One slash won't cut through my hide.
The closer you come, the harder it is to leave.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，来尝尝我的牛排！
lines.en: Sssss, taste my steak!
Get away, my steak's spicy!
Your sword won't hurt me!
I'm strongest in the sunlight!
Demon Steak Senior, here to eat you!
Try my Demon Steak!
Stay back, you'll get burned!
I won't come out in the sunlight!
You won't survive today!

lines.zh: 我的牛排是地狱的滋味！
lines.en: My steak is hellish!
My thick palm slams down and your blade veers off.
I don't dodge. I take the blow head-on.
Blood on the blade. It smells good.
My shoulder shoves you back three steps.
I remember how many times you have cut me.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的胳膊抬不起来了。
lines.en: After this, your arm won't lift.
My flesh sears, but I don't flinch.
I pin you in the shadow of a tree.
Here come the Demon Steak Seniors!
I won't spawn in the sunlight!
Evil spirits from the spawn egg!

lines.zh: 牛排味的恶鬼，夜里登场。
lines.en: A steak-bodied demon steps out at night.
My exclusive Demon Steak!

lines.zh: 我的巢里有刚煎好的肉。
lines.en: My nest holds meat fresh off the pan.
Watch out for my steak, Demon Slayer!
Darkness is my realm!
My weapon is the Demon Steak!
I rise out of the pile of roast meat.

lines.zh: 夜里，我带着一身肉味出现。
lines.en: At night I appear, reeking of meat.

lines.zh: 没有阳光，我便有了身体。
lines.en: No sunlight, and so I have a body.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳，被血养得很厚。
lines.en: This shell has been fattened on blood.

lines.zh: 我在屋脊的阴影里成形。
lines.en: I take shape in the shadow of a rooftop.
Fire rolls over me and my hide chars.
So much meat makes a dull thud on landing.
Soaked in water, my flesh comes apart.
The blast scorches half of me.
Even a thrown blade hurts.
Curses bite into my flesh.
Starving makes me feel light.
Lightning strikes and my flesh shrinks.
In the void, not even flesh stays.
